source_snapshot.procedure: Enable persistence, run level 4, then start service.

old_problem: DeepSeek used undocumented level 7 instead of source level 4, while plugin success lacked an approved target/ratio and independent PSU/feed/cooling evidence needed for high draw.
disposition_reason: NVIDIA documents canonical `targeted_power` in levels 3 and 4 with target and minimum-ratio parameters; numbered level 7 is not documented. Source level 4 remains authoritative under explicit power-path safety gates.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row365 all 18 XLSX columns and history2960.
Applied official targeted-power plugin selection and failure semantics.
No power workload, service or persistence change occurred.

test_case.test_name: DCGM level-4 targeted-power and end-to-end supply validation
test_case.purpose: Drive every selected GPU toward its pinned power target for the approved duration while proving target attainment, supply redundancy, cooling and device/host health.
required_package: Pinned DCGM/driver/GPU config and reviewed targeted-power script/hash
Explicit entities, target power, minimum ratio, duration and precision settings
Cooling/fan/ambient limits, hard stops, OOB and recovery
test_case.test_command: After drain, capacity and authorization gates, establish approved DCGM state and run the pinned source-level-4 suite once; retain targeted_power metrics/results plus synchronized GPU/platform/rail/PSU/fan/thermal telemetry, enforce hard stops, cool down and restore state.
test_case.expected_result: Each GPU reaches at least the pinned target ratio for the full required interval, all expected level-4 tests pass, feeds/PSUs retain approved redundancy/headroom, and no power, fan, thermal, XID, AER or host limit is crossed.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the named plugin oracle and independent end-to-end power-path evidence; undocumented level 7 or internal PASS during redundancy loss/throttling cannot pass.
safety_gate: Explicit authorization for high system draw
Verified redundant feeds, PSU and cooling capacity
Independent hard-stop monitoring with OOB emergency control
Abort on first excursion/event and never auto-retry
test_case.recovery: On excursion, abort immediately, keep redundant power/OOB, cool the platform, restore original service/persistence state, verify all feeds/PSUs/GPUs/host and do not rerun automatically.

source_conflict.reason: Official canonical plugin and source level-4 membership resolve scope and reject undocumented DeepSeek level 7.

blocked.reason: Power workload semantics are documented; exact target and platform envelope are runtime inputs.
